scoring_justification: Checker recomputes expected melting temperatures from the paper's analytic fit and verifies phase labels against the paper's reported stable phases; scoring via tolerance and trend for melting curves, and exact match for inverse Z results.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference melting temperatures from paper formulas and expected inverse Z phases.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper formulas: fcc-Pt Tm(P)=2042(1+P/44.3)^0.85, 9R-Pt Tm(P)=1500(1+P/20.0)^0.79; inverse Z results from paper's phase diagram: at (20 GPa,2500 K) fcc, at (40 GPa,2500 K) 9R, at (100 GPa,3000 K) 9R.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Analytic evaluation of paper's formulas and direct extraction from paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values derived from the paper, not invented.

outputs.description: Melting temperatures of fcc and 9R platinum at 0, 50, and 100 GPa computed via the direct Z method.
Most stable solid phase identified via inverse Z solidification at three (P,T) conditions.

output_contract.notes: The direct Z method requires running multiple AIMD simulations to bracket the melting point. The inverse Z method requires liquid preparation, supercooling, and an NVT solidification run. The agent may use Quantum ESPRESSO or another open-source AIMD code with appropriate pseudopotentials.

steps.description: Score melting temperatures against paper formulas with 15% tolerance and verify trend.
Score inverse Z phase identification against paper's reported phases.
